subject: Launch incentive structure — hybrid commit + usage credits
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurorahealth.ai>
To: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch incentive structure — exploring credits for initial rollout

Irene — thanks for the quick call earlier. Aurora is excited about building a patient-facing triage assistant on top of Redwood. A few items we need clarified before we take the pilot to our procurement team: 

- How would the free credits for a 60–90 day pilot be tracked against a later commitment? Is there a clawback if we don’t reach the commit?
- Can we get a clear per-token discount schedule that ties to committed volume over 12 months? We have bursty traffic and want protections for spikes.
- On security: we’ll need evidence of audit logging and data residency options for PHI routing — can you attach SOC/SLA references?

Can you send a single-page summary that we can share with procurement (they like concise tables)? Alex

---
Alex Nguyen
Head of Data & AI, Aurora Health
alex.nguyen@aurorahealth.ai
From: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurorahealth.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch incentive structure — hybrid commit + credit mechanics

Alex — great questions. I put together a short proposal (attached) that outlines two paths:

1) Hybrid commit (recommended for launch):
   - Customer commits to X tokens/month (12-month term) at a guaranteed effective per-token price.
   - We provide staged onboarding credits equal to ~25% of the first 3 months consumption to offset ramp cost.
   - Credits are additive to usage in the billing month and are consumed before billed usage.
   - Clawback: If total 12-month spend does not meet the committed minimum, unused credits are netted and a shortfall invoiced at the committed effective price (not list). No interest, one-time reconciliation.

2) Usage-led volume discount (no commit):
   - Pay-as-you-go with tiered per-token discounts based on trailing 30-day volume refresh.
   - No onboarding credits. Offers more flexibility but less price predictability.

Key notes: credits expire after 90 days, activation milestones tied to a production launch (simple health-check webhook + one usage test), and we can add a burst protection clause (automatic routing to a lower-cost compatible model for overflow).

I attached a one-pager and a sample projection (excel) for your consumption. Let me know which path procurement prefers and we’ll draft a short-term commercial term sheet.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attach: redwood_hybrid_incentive_v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages); usage_projection_aurora.xlsx (Excel)
From: procurement@aurorahealth.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurorahealth.ai>, jane.douglas@aurorahealth.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch incentive structure — quick procurement clarifications

Irene — procurement here. A couple of operational clarifications before we escalate to legal/finance: 

- Can you confirm whether the onboarding credits are reflected as a credit memo on invoices or as pre-paid credits applied to consumption? We prefer credit memos for audit.
- For the clawback, will Redwood provide a 30-day notification window before reconciliation invoice?
- Billing cadence: monthly invoices with net-30 preferred. Will Redwood accept net-45 for pilot customers?

Please provide the answers in a short list so our team can move quickly.

Procurement Lead (Aurora Health)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
To: procurement@aurorahealth.ai
Cc: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-05T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch incentive structure — payment and clawback mechanics

Thanks for the questions — quick answers below: 

- Credits: We apply onboarding credits as an automatically applied consumption credit line on the monthly invoice (visible as negative line items). We can also generate a credit memo on request for your accounting workflows.
- Clawback/notice: We will provide a 30-day preliminary usage reconciliation and notify you 30 days prior to any shortfall invoice. Reconciliation is a single line item and we never retroactively change historical invoices.
- Billing cadence: Standard is net-30. For pilots we can agree to net-45 for the first 90 days; longer terms depend on contract approval.

Two additional points: 
- We can gate the onboarding credits on a simple activation milestone (production traffic > 100k tokens in a 7-day rolling window OR a signed acceptance form).
- For spikes, we recommend our burst routing policy: overflow tokens are routed to a lower-cost but compatible model with a known per-token fallback price (we include per-token fallback rates in the term sheet).

Ben (finance) and Marissa (sales ops) are copied for signature and invoicing templates. If this looks ok, Irene will send a term sheet for legal.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
From: irene.choi@redwood-inference.com
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@aurorahealth.ai>, procurement@aurorahealth.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2026-10-07T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch incentive structure — term sheet & next steps

Alex / Aurora procurement — attaching a short commercial term sheet draft based on the hybrid path. Highlights: 

- Commit: 18M tokens over 12 months (flex: monthly smoothing allowed).
- Effective per-token price at commit level: $0.0009/token (post-credits).
- Onboarding credits: 4.5M tokens issued as an invoice credit (visible on invoice) valid for first 90 days post-activation.
- Reconciliation: 30-day notice and single shortfall invoice if 12-month committed minimum is not met.
- Pilot terms: net-45 for first 90 days, SOC2 excerpt and data residency checklist included in appendix.

Next steps: if you confirm interest, we’ll: (1) lock commercial terms for 7 days while legal drafts SOW; (2) generate DocuSign for signature; (3) provision dedicated throttles for launch week. 

If procurement needs the invoice-credit memo in place of automatic invoice credit, we can accommodate that — Ben, can you prepare both templates?

Alex — are you available for a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk procurement through the boarding milestones?

Thanks,
Irene
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
